verdict.rationale: Zep supports some bulk-like actions — deleting a User cascades to delete all associated Threads/artifacts in a single call (useful for RTBF), and zepctl CLI offers terminal-based administration of users, threads, and graphs that could be scripted for bulk operations. However, there is no documented batch/bulk API (e.g., bulk ingest, bulk delete of many arbitrary items, bulk edge/node operations) for AI-native automation. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints for ingesting or deleting many items at once, documentation or examples of scripting zepctl for bulk operations, and independent confirmation of bulk performance/reliability.
